name: Zamin — PRATIK Ternary Silicon
description: Hardware-realization blueprint for the PRATIK balanced-ternary substrate of the PEDLER Event Algebra: MTCMOS three-rail ternary logic with a physical high-impedance poised-zero, a complementary dual-memristor 3D crossbar with autogenous dimension spawning, spatial linguistic compilation, TSV routing, and microfluidic cooling. Includes a SPICE cell library and testbench, a gdsfactory layout generator, an IEEE manuscript, and a dependency-free WYSIWYG ternary-circuit simulator.
